summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical compatibility and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns explicit candidate roles, with only normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input authorizing; compute independent sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; selection binds roles, repo-relative paths, modules, scope, resource sets; content binds selected-path bytes; adapter owns transport, page ranges, continuation validity, coverage, truncation; complete adapter coverage prevents summary truncation; ready receipts require immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; atomically advance validated non-authorizing current pointer; consumers resolve pointer only, never mtimes, suffixes, scans; independent execution/publication/semantic-review Knowledge gates; derive Knowledge self-change from changed-set and canonical path policy, not caller flag; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, unexpired active attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers to v2 before 8-18 creates new current receipt; existing skill-input-current* directories remain immutable historical evidence; ADR does not create lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
